authenticity_review: Perceptual quality auditor reported no graphics-level distortions (noise, blur, compression), which aligns with the clean studio-like appearance. However, independent visual inspection reveals two structural artifacts: (1) The wheels of the front-left suitcase lack proper ground contact shadows and appear partially fused into the floor plane (severity ~2); (2) The lower limbs of the striped toy show texture bleeding where they meet the suitcase surface, losing knitted definition (severity ~1). These are characteristic generative artifacts that don't affect overall scene coherence but prevent a perfect authenticity score. The SAM mask confidence (0.98) indicates good boundary segmentation for the tested region but doesn't rule out local fusion issues elsewhere.
